description: This Java class 'ScreenWidgetArtifactInfo' models and manages information about screen widgets within the OFBiz framework, including their associated entities, services, forms, and linked requests. It provides methods to populate and retrieve related artifacts and references.

classes.name: ScreenWidgetArtifactInfo
classes.description: Represents and manages information about a screen widget, including its associated entities, services, forms, and linked requests within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: populateAll
methods.description: Populates related artifacts such as services, entities, forms, and requests linked to this screen widget.

methods.name: populateServicesFromNameSet
methods.description: Populates the set of services used in this screen based on a set of service names.

methods.name: populateEntitiesFromNameSet
methods.description: Populates the set of entities used in this screen based on a set of entity names.

methods.name: populateFormsFromNameSet
methods.description: Populates the set of forms included in this screen based on a set of form names.

methods.name: populateLinkedRequests
methods.description: Populates the set of requests linked to this screen based on request unique IDs.
